title: Wayfarers and Camps
blurb: People out in the wild who ask for help and teach what they know.

steps.hint: Ilse and Hettie are there. Look for the smoke north of the High Gate.

steps.text: Finish a bounty from Hale's board.
steps.hint: Take one from his post and bring back what it asks for.

finish.line: You know the people out there.
